Drafting (aerodynamics).subject: Applied Sciences
Drafting (aerodynamics).question: The _____ was Aerodynamic technique.
Drafting (aerodynamics).fact: Drafting, or slipstreaming, is an aerodynamic technique where two moving objects are aligning in a close group to exploit the lead object's slipstream and thus reduce the overall effect of drag. Especially when high speeds are involved, as in motor racing and cycling, drafting can significantly reduce the paceline's average energy expenditure and can even slightly reduce the energy expenditure of the lead vehicle.

Drafting (writing).subject: Applied Sciences
Drafting (writing).question: The _____ was Process to create preliminary versions of a written work.
Drafting (writing).fact: Drafting is the process by which preliminary forms of a written work are composed. Separate from other steps of the writing process, such as revision and editing, drafting involves the initial creation of the main content, structure, and style of a work.

Drag coefficient.subject: Applied Sciences
Drag coefficient.question: The _____ was Dimensionless parameter to quantify fluid resistance.

It is used in the drag equation in which a lower drag coefficient indicates the object will have less aerodynamic or hydrodynamic drag.

Émigré.subject: Applied Sciences
Émigré.question: To escape political tensions and sometimes in fear for their lives, some emigrated from France, settling in neighboring countries, chiefly _____, Spain, Germany, Austria, and Prussia
Émigré.fact: Common destinations were other parts of the British Empire, such as Upper Canada, Nova Scotia, Great Britain, Jamaica, and the British West Indies. To escape political tensions and sometimes in fear for their lives, some emigrated from France, settling in neighboring countries, chiefly Great Britain, Spain, Germany, Austria, and Prussia.

Émigré.question: According to the _____ Australian census there are 145,683 South African émigrés, born in South Africa, in Australia, of whom 30,291 reside in the city of Perth or greater Perth area
